reviews.title: Not A Mealime Alternative
reviews.text:
We tried this app after Mealime shut down and unfortunately this one was not for us. There were some interesting recipes but nothing that seemed healthy and within our dietary restrictions, even after choosing not to use certain ingredients. We bought wine because it was in our shopping list from the app thinking it was for cooking recipes we selected.. nope.. they were wine pairings and we didn’t realize until we cooked the meal. So we opened our bottle, ate food we shouldn’t be eating because we cooked it, and cried over Mealime app being gone. Then we deleted this app forever. 

I’m sure it’s great for other people, just not for us.

reviews.title: Not a plan; just random recipes
reviews.text: I really wanted to love eMeals. Paid for 2 years - Mediterranean plan. First, their Mediterranean diet is what White Americans think Mediterranean food is. So if your goal was to eat Mediterranean for its great health benefits, you will be disappointed. Second, the repeat of recipes is insane. Third, the weekly plan feels just random. I thought a weekly plan will mean shared ingredients. Isn’t the point of planning to reduce waste and save money? And fourth, which is what bugs me the most and why I won’t spend another dollar on it - when you stop paying their membership, you lose access to all your past recipes.

reviews.title: Expensive for what you get
reviews.text: Bland meals, does not accommodate larger families, ordering portions are off, recipes are unappetizing and lazy (shrimp on a hot dog bun…what? Unseasoned chicken and broccoli on white rice…boring), did the 14 day trial and got charged for all kinds of plans I didn’t want, huge waste of money

reviews.title: Trial beware
reviews.text: I used a different meal planning app in the past and needed a replacement. I wanted to give this a try but you can only try it when you sign up for a free trial. I didn’t like it and deleted the app, and thought I signed up through the App Store for a subscription but it was actually through PayPal so I didn’t cancel it. Now I got charged $60 for a years subscription to an app I’ve deleted and only used a few days. I contacted customer support and was told they don’t give refunds.

reviews.title: Garbage
reviews.text: We don’t drink alcohol and there is no way to turn off the “wine pairing suggestion” obnoxious. And the pop up ads and specific brand names - more commercial than useful disappointing.

reviews.title: Not
reviews.text: It is not connecting right with the Walmart app. I added everything and it’s not showing on the Walmart app on my account- and then I went back in through emeals and my whole list was gone.

reviews.title: Not worth it.  Additional year charged without notification.
reviews.text: Not worth the price.  A free AI meal plan is much more personalized and useful.

reviews.title: Works but Nonstandard Subscription Terms
reviews.text: The app and overall meal planning process does work. It allows planning meals of your dietary choice and integrated shopping orders. The gotcha is that they do NOT offer ANY refunds on subscriptions prorated or otherwise as do the majority of vendors I have worked with. The cancellation process is a convoluted, many click process that could be one button in my opinion. Beware of this.

reviews.title: Scammy
reviews.text: If I could give no stars I would. Besides not being transparent about pricing, they don’t really offer any value. Also after not being transparent about pricing they will charge you and refuse to give refunds on paid subscriptions even though I’ve canceled and I’m no longer using their “service.” Extremely disappointed. They definitely need to be more transparent with pricing and actually offer more for $60/month.

reviews.title: Love the idea, but the execution is awful
reviews.text:
I did a free trial a while ago, but didn’t actually use the app or test any recipes. This week I decided to try using the app again and actually meal plan and prepare the meals, and I noticed several things. 

1. I wish the app had an option to continue on a monthly basis instead of choosing 3 months or a year. I unfortunately am cancelling my membership primarily for this reason. 
2. The AI doesn’t do a very good job creating lists from the recipes. It was really annoying to have to do the work of ensuring that the grocery items and their respective amounts actually line of with the recipes. From what I understand, that was supposed to be the whole point. But I wound up having to go through the list and manually make several changes. I really feel that I shouldn’t have to edit the grocery list so drastically. Also the fact that it includes recommended wine pairings in the grocery list is an obvious and obnoxious upsell. 
3. The recipes don’t offer metric measurements, even though the ingredient list largely goes off of oz. Some of us still prefer to use and kitchen scale in the US, especially when making lists so we know we have the proper ingredient amounts. 
4z for some reason when I chose my plan, it charged me twice: once for a yearly plan and once for a 3-month plan. I am still trying to figure out how to get refunded.

reviews.title: Good not great.
reviews.text:
The recipes are good. The variety is good. 
Makes dinner easy. 
I don’t care for the strong Walmart delivery suggestions. 
I don’t care for the wine pairing added to my shopping list each recipe. 
Needs to be an option to change side dish or drop it all together.

reviews.title: Glitchy
reviews.text: I love the concept, but half the time there’s an error sending my list to Walmart, and I have to start over. Forget it.

reviews.title: Stuck in May
reviews.text: I have used this app for almost a year now and I absolutely loved it…until now. My app has been stuck in may for over two months. I believe it’s stuck on May 6th and it is now July 17th. Very disappointing.

reviews.title: App isn’t working
reviews.text: Every time I try to select anything it says it isn’t working

reviews.title: No flavors
reviews.text:
Recipes should include seasonings! Everything I tried during my trial was next to flavorless before I added a bunch to it. 
The technical functionality of the app and being able to easily build your shopping list based on recipes for the week is great! The recipes just need a lot of work before I will pay and fully subscribe to this service.

reviews.title: Unusable
reviews.text: The app will add dozens of random ingredients to the shopping list. I had 9 12 oz bags of broccoli when I needed 3. 9 bell peppers when I needed 3. The list goes on and on. It’s to the point where it’s completely unusable. I reached out for help and was told I need to double check the list. But it’s very time I order that there’s a huge problem.

reviews.title: Cost
reviews.text: This looks like a great service, but I had to sign up for a 14 day trial before I know Price options. I had to go to Google and get all the information about what you offer.hiding your cost until you’re committed always makes me leery.

reviews.title: Aggressively push alcohol
reviews.text: It recommends alcoholic drinks in your meal plan, and then it also automatically adds suggested wine pairings to your grocery list based on the meals you added. No, you cannot turn either of these "features" off.
